examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Pick a start and an end day. The second click completes the range and closes the picker. Without `value` it keeps its own state.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Pass `value` and `onValueChange` to own the range. `clearable` adds an x that empties it.

examples.title: Presets
examples.description: The rail on the left holds Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month and Last month. The preset that matches the current range is highlighted, and the arrow keys move between them.

examples.title: Longer look-backs
examples.description: `EXTENDED_DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` adds Last 90 days, This quarter and Year to date to the default six.

examples.title: Financial year
examples.description: `getFinancialYearPresets()` adds This and Last financial year, starting in April. Pass another start month, for example `getFinancialYearPresets(0)` for the calendar year.

examples.title: Custom presets
examples.description: A preset is a label and a `getRange` function. A preset that falls outside `minDate` and `maxDate` is disabled.

examples.title: No presets
examples.description: Pass `presets={[]}` to show only the calendar, for example for booking dates.

examples.title: Two months
examples.description: `months="auto"` shows two months side by side when the page is at least 712px wide and one below that. Use `months={2}` to always show two. The default is one month.

examples.title: Date limits
examples.description: `minDate` and `maxDate` dim the days outside the window and disable the presets that fall outside it.

examples.title: Future dates only
examples.description: `disablePastDates` is a shortcut for a `minDate` of today.

examples.title: Week start and locale
examples.description: `weekStartsOn={1}` starts the week on Monday. `locale` takes a BCP 47 tag and translates month names, weekdays and day labels.

examples.title: Summary line
examples.description: The line under the calendar reads the range and its length. `formatSummary` translates it, and `showSummary={false}` hides it.

examples.title: Compact label
examples.description: `formatDateRangeCompact` shortens the field text, for example `7 – 13 Oct 2026`. Pass it to `formatRange`; the default text is unchanged.

examples.title: Clearing
examples.description: `onClear` runs after the range is cleared, next to `onValueChange({})`. `clearLabel` names the button for assistive technology.

examples.title: Controlled open state
examples.description: `open` and `onOpenChange` let another control open and close the picker.

examples.title: Form integration
examples.description: Label the field with `aria-labelledby`, link the hint with `aria-describedby` and set `state="error"` for a missing range.

examples.title: Keyboard
examples.description: The calendar is one tab stop with arrow-key movement. Opening from the keyboard puts focus on it, and Tab or Escape returns to the field.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled picker cannot be opened or cleared.
